english.title: Alter test / goods / plating etc certificate with intent to deceive
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with intent to deceive altered

(A)_[a test certificate]_
(B)_[a goods vehicle test certificate]_
(C)_[a plating certificate]_
(D)_[a certificate of conformity]_
(E)_[a minister's approval certificate]_
(F)_[a certificate issued under section 14 of the Road Traffic Act 1988]_
(G)_[a seal required by regulations made under section 41 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 with respect to speed limiters]_
(H)_[a plate containing particulars required to be marked on a vehicle by regulations under section 41 of the Road Traffic Act 1988]_
(I)_[a plate containing particulars required to be marked on a goods vehicle by sections 54 and 58 of the Road Traffic Act 1988]_
(J)_[a document evidencing the appointment of an examiner under section 66A of the Road Traffic Act 1988]_
(K)_[a record required to be kept by virtue of section 74 of the Road Traffic Act 1988]_
(L)_[a document evidencing the result of a test of competence to drive]_

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
